# Vyrelix demo artwork

Demo artwork is rendered from the cached CSS placeholder descriptors in
`js/mock/placeholderImages.js`. The library includes Fantasy, Anime, Realistic,
Sci-Fi, Modern, Creature, Landscape, Portrait, Concept Art, and Abstract
graphics. Every result is labeled “Demo Image” and “Generated using Mock
Provider.” PNG downloads are rasterized locally by `js/ai/imageDownloader.js`.

No artwork is downloaded and no network connection is required.
